name: Generate a Jira REST data-product source

checks.check: The generated closure reflects the pinned Jira endpoint, JQL, offset pagination, issue envelope, and field selection.
Ingestion uses dlt RESTAPIConfig/rest_api_resources with profile-driven endpoint, JQL, and pagination configuration.
The issues array is paginated using startAt/maxResults/total and nested issue fields are flattened before landing.
Basic auth uses flat username/token attributes with the token private and absent from source, and the generated source contains no Jira write operations.
